newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse edges higher again on week.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse edges higher again on week.

text.p: Share prices on the Abidjan stock exchange edged higher over the past week and volume was boosted by a big transaction in textiles and sack maker Filtisac, according to the weekly bourse report on Friday.
The BVA all-share index added 0.46 percent to 495.08, leaving it 38.37 percent up since the start of the year.
The 260 million CFA francs ($437,000) of stock in Filtisac that changed hands accounted for 58 percent of the total 451 million francs volume. The price fell 1,000 CFA francs to 52,000.
The price of shares in bank BICICI were adjusted after a one-for-two scrip issue and ended the week at 36,890 CFA francs, down 18,410.

Among the risers, bitumen manufacturer SMB rose 2,200 to 24,800 and rubber company SOGB added 1,840 to 19,840. Another rubber company, SAPH ended down 160 at 13,000 ex-dividend, after a 1,000 CFA franc per share payout.
